summary: Hosted service: choosable reasoning levels and a cheaper Balanced reviewer. GPT-6.1 Terra replaces GPT-6.1 Sol as the Balanced reviewer at half its price; Standard keeps Sol. The model editor now offers Writer and Reviewer reasoning levels from the levels each model allows, and a changed level keeps the preset's name, as in "Balanced · writer high". The start confirmation names each role's level, run details show the level each role ran at, and the cost scenario notes a level above the default. The API takes an optional level per role on a run start and an application's pair, and the model catalog lists each model's default and allowed levels. Credit rule v2 doubles a run's base when either role runs at high, extra high or max, like a premium model; reservations record the rule version.
knownLimitations: Staging only: production keeps its earlier images until the owner deploys this tag there. Staging runs behind the owner token, so sign-in, plans and credits are not exercised there until the identity provider is hosted, and credit rule v2 is proven by tests only. No paid run has measured what a raised level costs or adds to quality, so the cost scenario shows no multiplier, and GPT-6.1 Terra as the reviewer is unvalidated. Workspaces saved on the old Balanced pair show a custom pair until Balanced is applied again. The cost of a complete cached run is still to measure (#1597).
